coding.note: Claims are release/framework contributions stated in the abstract and introduction, not architectural novelty: the architectural choices in Section 2.1 are explicitly adopted from prior work. Framework components are separated where distinct resources are introduced. MULTI refers to the two hardware-cluster training runs, not repeated matched-seed experiments; no across-run uncertainty is reported. FULL data disclosure is supported by released artifacts reconstructing exact batch composition and order. Hardware and energy are disclosed, but no GPU-hours, FLOPs, or hardware-times-duration total is given, so compute is N. Comparator scores are treated as author-evaluated under the fixed pipeline; use of external benchmark software or GPT judges is not an independent third-party evaluation. Quotes retain extraction line breaks and, where necessary, interleaved column text.
